items.summary: Run one cheap PPO sweep with --rollout-vs-pool against a hand-built pool of W6/iter-{0,1,2} promoted checkpoints. Materially different from R5 (which used the item17 DAgger pool ~30pp weaker). Plumbing caveat: today's _select_pool_opponent picks one opponent per run uniformly, not per-game PFSP — accept that as the v1 experiment.

items.summary: Scope item from F1 post-mortem #1: a 'better warm-start' (more games, more epochs, possibly entropy-regularized BC during the BC stage) might give PPO room to move. Pre-R12 evidence suggested entropy intervention alone didn't break the cap; this is specifically the SL-scaling angle, not entropy alone.
